only_this_entry_leaves_the_library_game_: Only this entry leaves the library. Game files, prefix, saves, settings, logs and shortcuts stay on disk.
the_prefix_will_be_permanently_deleted_w: The prefix will be permanently deleted, with the game, programs and saves inside it.
the_prefix_and_the_game_stay_on_disk_the: The prefix and the game stay on disk; they only leave the library.
deletes_the_wine_proton_folder_and_every: Deletes the Wine/Proton folder and everything installed in it, saves included.
deletes_the_game_record_and_log_folders_: Deletes the game record and log folders. When removing the prefix too, also deletes profiles and mod data created by PeliGames. Mod recovery backups are preserved.
keeps_all_files_and_removes_only_this_pe: Keeps all files and removes only this PeliGames entry.
all_games_using_this_prefix_leave_the_li: All games using this prefix leave the library, with their shortcuts. Complete cleanup includes associated PeliGames data outside the prefix; external game files not owned by PeliGames are preserved.
